title: Across ED visit bucket (last 6 months)
one_line_definition: This chart compares the count of targeted care gaps across patient segments defined by their frequency of emergency department visits in the last 6 months.
result_meaning: [{"movement": "Tallest bar in the 0 ED visits bucket", "signal": "Positive", "interpretation": "Most targeted gaps are concentrated in patients with no recent ED utilization, suggesting opportunities for proactive outreach before acute events occur."}, {"movement": "Tallest bar in the 3+ ED visits bucket", "signal": "Negative", "interpretation": "High-frequency ED users carry the greatest burden of unaddressed gaps, indicating that complex, high-risk patients are not receiving adequate preventive or chronic care management."}, {"movement": "Progressively rising bars from low to high ED visit buckets", "signal": "Investigate", "interpretation": "A stepwise increase in targeted gaps as ED utilization rises suggests a systemic failure to close care gaps before patients escalate to emergency-level care, warranting urgent care coordination review."}]
